# TechOmnis

> A founder-led product studio for web, mobile and AI

## About

TechOmnis is a product studio that designs, engineers and ships web, mobile and AI products to production. Founded in 2024, we work with teams across the US, UK and UAE.

## Services

- **Production Rescue**: We take AI-built, legacy or stalled products to production.
- **Product Design**: UX/UI, design systems and prototypes built by a team that ships code.
- **Product Engineering**: Web apps, SaaS, marketplaces and mobile apps on one backend.
- **AI Systems**: RAG, copilots, chatbots and agents with evals, cost limits and tracing.
- **Mobile Apps**: iOS and Android in Flutter or React Native, sharing backend and design.

## Tech Stack

Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Vue, Node, Python, Postgres, Supabase, Firebase, MongoDB, Redis, Stripe, AWS, Google Cloud, Vercel, Docker, Flutter, React Native, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Vertex AI
